# OneFlow Copilot Guide

## Big Picture
- Shipping a Plasmo MV3 browser extension with a React popup (`popup.tsx`) and Tailwind styling (`style.css`).
- Automation flows live in `lib/automation` and are surfaced through the popup quick actions.
- Avoid touching `build/**`; those bundles come from Plasmo and are regenerated by `pnpm build`.

## Automation Workflows
- `WorkflowManager` (`lib/automation/workflow-manager.ts`) queues runs, enforces serial execution by default, and exposes `subscribe` for UI state.
- Tasks are plain `TaskDefinition` objects (`lib/automation/types.ts`); the runner stores each step's output in a shared `Map` when `step.id` is set.
- Actions register through the `registerAction` map in `lib/automation/actions.ts`; call `requireAction` inside tests or new code to fail fast when an action is missing.
- `runTask` (`lib/automation/runner.ts`) wires callbacks (`onStepStart`, etc.) and propagates AbortSignals for cancellation.
- When adding an action, return `{ success, output, meta }`; populate `meta` with trace-friendly data so the popup can render diagnostics.

## Content Extraction
- `read-page` delegates to `contents/read-page.ts`, which uses `extractDocumentContent` for DOM cloning, pruning ignored tags, and normalizing text.
- Directory `lib/automation/extraction.ts` centralizes selectors, sanitization, and formatting helpers; reuse `normalizeExtractedText`, `sanitizeHtmlFragment`, and `formatExtractedContent` instead of reimplementing.
- In tests or server-like contexts, prefer `source: "html"` with `context.pageContent` because `chrome.tabs` is unavailable.
- Extraction metadata (title/url/length/debug) powers the popup details card—update `meta` keys cautiously to avoid UI regressions.

## Popup & Presets
- Quick actions in `popup.tsx` read from `PRESET_REGISTRY` (`lib/automation/presets.ts`); add new presets there and wire a matching entry in `QUICK_ACTIONS`.
- Sample data toggle feeds `context.pageContent`; keep presets resilient to both live pages and sample strings.
- UI components under `components/ui` assume Tailwind classes merged with `cn` (`lib/utils.ts`); follow that helper when assembling className props.
- `TaskIndicator` expects the workflow manager to drive counts; pass callbacks instead of accessing internals.

## Debugging & Observability
- Enable rich traces with `pnpm run dev:debug` (sets `PLASMO_PUBLIC_AUTOMATION_DEBUG=true`) or toggle at runtime via `window.__AUTO_BORING_DEBUG__ = true`.
- `createScopedDebugger` and `createDebugTrace` (`lib/debug.ts`) gate logging; append stages like `extraction-success` so UI debug dumps stay meaningful.
- Step metadata can include a `debug` array; the popup renders it under "Debug trace"—keep entries concise JSON strings.

## Dev Workflow & Conventions
- Use `pnpm dev` for hot-reloading the popup, `pnpm test` for Vitest suites under `lib/automation/__tests__`, and `pnpm build` before packaging.
- Path alias `@/` resolves to project root (see imports like `@/lib/automation`); stick with it for shared modules.
- Tailwind config (`tailwind.config.js`) already scopes the design tokens; extend through layers in `style.css` rather than inline styles.
- When touching automation logic, add or update Vitest coverage near `lib/automation/__tests__/automation.spec.ts` to confirm fallbacks and queue behavior.

## Integration Notes
- Chrome APIs (`chrome.tabs.query/sendMessage`) are only reachable inside extension contexts; guard or inject fallbacks when running outside the browser.
- Content script (`contents/read-page.ts`) must return promptly—ensure new logic stays synchronous or resolves before `sendResponse` completes.
- Store run-level IDs via the manager's `idGenerator` if you need deterministic tests; existing spec overrides it to keep assertions stable.
